NGA.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy says it launched GovGuide Nigeria with Meta, NCAIR and Publica AI, a fully operational voice and text AI chatbot on the web giving information on government services in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy; built by Publica AI with NCAIR

NGA.note: GovGuide is a general government-services chatbot, not a sector system.
GovGuide is built on Meta's Llama models by a local developer, and the document names no model, dataset or computing released as such.
